description: Free mechanical pre-check before a paid verification review: given a claims object mapping each criterion key (approvalGates, restartRecovery, evidenceTrail, killSwitch, policyControls, isolation) to a public documentation URL, reports which criteria have documentation linked and which are missing. It checks that links were supplied, never that the documentation proves the claim.

claims.description: Map of criterion key to public documentation URL.

name: pre_check
